name: versions inherit settings without mutating their base version
input: a base embedder configuration and a derived version

name: activation and request overrides do not persist
input: an active version and a valid one-request batch-size override
test:
registry = MLConfigRegistry()
registry.register('ranker', 1, {'learning_rate': 0.001, 'batch_size': 32, 'enabled': True})
registry.register('ranker', 3, {'learning_rate': 0.0005}, base_version=1)
registry.activate('ranker', 3)
assert registry.resolve('ranker') == {'learning_rate': 0.0005, 'batch_size': 32, 'enabled': True}
assert registry.resolve('ranker', overrides={'batch_size': 64}) == {'learning_rate': 0.0005, 'batch_size': 64, 'enabled': True}
assert registry.resolve('ranker')['batch_size'] == 32
assert registry.versions('ranker') == [1, 3]

name: unknown versions and invalid updates leave existing versions usable
input: a registered model followed by duplicate and invalid registrations
